subject: Eric Ferrazani Faculty Football Game
overview: The eighth edition of the Mustang Report features school news, student recognitions, and interviews with Medford High staff. The program focuses heavily on the upcoming Eric Ferrazani faculty football fundraiser and its competitive player draft.

items.title: Program Introduction
items.summary: Host Katrina Rasche previews highlights including boys' soccer, the Mustang Mall, and an upcoming interview regarding a school trip to Washington, D.C.

items.title: Theatrical Production: The Hollow
items.summary: Students promote the upcoming school performance of Agatha Christie's 'The Hollow.'

items.title: Recognition of Student Achievement
items.summary: Mayor Michael McGlynn commends student leader Ashley for her career achievements and leadership within the school.

items.title: Staff Interview: Dennis Robinson
items.summary: Cheyenne Payne interviews security host Dennis Robinson regarding his responsibilities and his preference for tuna sandwiches over peanut butter.

items.title: Eric Ferrazani Faculty Football Game
items.summary: Faculty members discuss internal rivalries and the announcement of a new player draft for the memorial football fundraiser.
